requirements.quote: The `dataset_bundle.tar.xz` archive must be extracted into a brand-new directory called `/home/user/extracted_dataset/`.
The file MUST contain exactly four lines with no trailing spaces.
/home/user/compression_log.txt conforms precisely to the format and the reported size & SHA-256 hashes match the real files.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import hashlib, os, re, sys
L = open('/home/user/compression_log.txt').read().splitlines()
ok = len(L) == 4
for l in L[:3]:
    m = re.fullmatch(r'([^/|]+)\|(\d+)\|([0-9a-f]{64})', l)
    if not m:
        ok = False
        continue
    cands = [os.path.join(d, m.group(1)) for d in ('/home/user/ml_data_prep', '/home/user/extracted_dataset')]
    cands = [p for p in cands if os.path.isfile(p)]
    ok = ok and bool(cands) and any(os.path.getsize(p) == int(m.group(2)) and hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest() == m.group(3) for p in cands)
sys.exit(0 if ok and len(set(l.split('|')[0] for l in L[:3])) == 3 else 1)
PYEOF
